name: expense-webapp

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Loads and changes claims, approvals, exports and people.

description: The one browser app for employees, managers and finance. Each role sees its own screens: my claims and the claim form, the approvals queue and claim review, the payroll export, and the people list. It calls expense-api with the signed-in user's token and holds no data of its own; it does not talk to storage or email directly.
